goongi.tooltip: If you can stop Qiongqi without disturbing the balance of spring, you will be able to receive its blessing.
goongi.tooltip2: If you fight against Kaling by stopping Qiongqi without disturbing the balance of Spring, you will receive a blessing that protects you from fatal damage one time.
goongi.tooltip3: You were unable to gain the protection blessing because the balance of spring was disrupted.

dool.tooltip: If you can stop Taowu without disturbing the balance of summer, you will be able to receive its blessing.
dool.tooltip2: If you fight against Kaling by stopping Taowu without disturbing the balance of summer, you will gain the Purification ability in the winter.
dool.tooltip3: You were unable to gain the Purification ability because the balance of summer was disrupted.

hondon.tooltip: If you can stop Hundun without disturbing the balance of autumn, you will be able to receive its blessing.
hondon.tooltip2: If you fight against Kaling by stopping Hundun without harming the balance of autumn, you will receive a boost that will increase your Final Damage.
hondon.tooltip3: You were unable to gain the boost because the balance of autumn was disrupted.

icon.tooltip: Taowu is weakened by the electric current the Tesla coils absorbed.
Hundun enters the dark clouds and draws energy from them, increasing his power and recovering his health.
